description: Linear Algebra is an interesting and challenging course because it is so abstract and fundamental in modern Mathematics. Linear Algebra is essentially about vector spaces and linear transformations between vector spaces. Topics include finite dimensional real vector spaces, subspaces of a vector space, linear combinations of vectors and linear independence, bases and dimension of a vector space, systems of linear equations and matrices, orthonormal basis of inner product spaces, linear transformations between vector spaces, determinant of linear transformations and matrices, matrix representation of linear transformations between finite dimensional vector spaces, eigenvalues and eigenvectors, and invariant subspaces. We will cover all of Chapter 1, 2, 3, 4, most of Chapter 8 and some of Chapter 9 in Linear and Geometric Algebra by Alan Macdonald.
